integrity: Analytical proof and finite standard-library verifier are included; finite checks are not treated as proof of the all-n claim.
scientific_limitations: Independent exponential, irreversible species extinctions only; no empirical calibration and no extension to correlated extinction, time-varying hazards or recolonization. Classical exponential Chebyshev lemma acknowledged. Inaccessible Engen (2007) full text presents a remaining bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp temporal mode bound for variance of surviving-species richness
